description: Curated things-to-do / events for a DoStuff metro. Defaults to today; pass `date` and/or `days` to cover a window (e.g. a weekend). Optionally filter by category (music, art, performing-arts, comedy, food-drink, other-fun-deals) and free-only. Sorted by start time.

date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today, US Eastern).

days.description: How many days from the start date to include (1-7, default 1). Use 3 for a weekend.

free_only.description: If true, only return free events.

metro.description: Metro slug: nyc, chicago, boston, austin, san-antonio, sf-bay. Use the metros tool to list.

name: events
title: Events
